payload.core_mechanism_summary: DFS tree DP computing subtree sums and using max-sum of two disjoint subtrees via best-two per node.
payload.rationale: Solution uses post-order DFS to compute s[u] (subtree sum) and h[u] = max(max child h, s[u]), then ans = max(h1+h2) for top two children's h values, a classic tree DP.
